commands:
set -e
make defconfig
# Disable features that break with modern kernel headers / -Werror
sed -i \
  -e 's/^CONFIG_WERROR=y/# CONFIG_WERROR is not set/' \
  -e 's/^CONFIG_TC=y/# CONFIG_TC is not set/' \
  -e 's/^CONFIG_FEATURE_TC_INGRESS=y/# CONFIG_FEATURE_TC_INGRESS is not set/' \
  .config
printf '%s\n' 'CONFIG_WERROR=n' >> .config
make olddefconfig || make oldconfig </dev/null || true
grep -E 'CONFIG_WERROR|CONFIG_TC=' .config || true
make -j"$(nproc)" SKIP_STRIP=y
